title: Long Division: Exact
summary: Solve 864 ÷ 4 using the traditional division bracket and a repeatable four-step cycle.
shortcut: How many? → Times → Take away → Drop

steps.title: How many?
steps.explanation: Ask how many groups of 4 fit inside 8. Put 2 above the 8.

steps.title: Times
steps.explanation: Multiply the quotient digit by the divisor and write 8 underneath.

steps.title: Take away
steps.explanation: Subtract to find what is left.

steps.title: Drop
steps.explanation: Bring the next digit beside the remainder. Repeat the cycle.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.explanation: Write 1 above the 6, subtract 4 from 6, then bring down the 4 to make 24.

steps.title: Finish
steps.explanation: Write 6 above the 4. Since 6 × 4 = 24, the remainder is 0.

why: Long division works because each quotient digit tells how many groups of the divisor fit into the current place-value chunk.
notes: Keep quotient digits lined up above the dividend digits.
Always multiply before subtracting.
A remainder must be smaller than the divisor.
shortcut_literature: How many? → Times → Take away → Drop
Say the rule out loud before each step.
Check the answer by reversing the operation whenever possible.
